item.title: Clare Public Urged Not To Mix Alcohol And Swimming Over Festive Period
item.description: Anyone visiting Clare’s coastline over the festive period is being urged not to to enter the county’s waters after consuming alcohol. The RNLI is reminding people that they will be on call over Christmas to assist anyone who gets into danger and advises people to ‘Float to Live’ should they find themselves in trouble. item.title: Clare IFA Chair Claims Potential Impact Of Mercusor Deal In The New Year ‘Difficult To Comprehend’
item.description: The Chair of the Clare branch of the IFA says it’s ‘difficult to comprehend’ the impact the Mercusor trade deal would have if fully implemented in the new year. The trade agreement would see up to 99,000 tonnes of beef exported into the EU along with over 180,000 tonnes of poultry.
